summary: Verified badge text contrast fix on Activity Log (/activity) and Users (/users) pages in both LIGHT and DARK themes using getComputedStyle. Bug is FIXED — badges now use variant 'chip' with proper foreground token. Login flow with super admin (zulfame/password) works and lands on dashboard.

DARK /activity: 'Info' color=rgb(10,10,10) bg=rgb(97,166,250); 'Sukses' color=rgb(10,10,10) bg=rgb(69,211,121). Users LIGHT & DARK: 'Aktif' color=rgb(255,255,255) bg=rgb(27,157,74); 'Nonaktif' color=rgb(255,255,255) bg=rgb(115,115,115). No console errors observed on either page/theme. rca_of_the_issue: Previous CSS class .state-chip (used on outline Badge) lost specificity to Tailwind text-foreground utility, so on light theme the chip text inherited near-black color even though bg was solid blue -> low contrast. Fix moved styling into a cva 'chip' variant on Badge.vue with bg-[hsl(var(--chip))] text-[hsl(var(--background))], ensuring foreground token flips per theme. Verified via computed styles.
